title: echinops spinosissimus subsp. macrolepis
intro: Echinops spinosissimus subsp. macrolepis, commonly known as Globe Thistle, is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. Globe Thistle is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and fighting off infections due to its antimicrobial and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Globe Thistle are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, improve circulation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Globe Thistle include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
